architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Reusable components in src/components/. CSS modules for styling. React Router v6 for navigation. No state management lib (useContext + useReducer for global state). Vite for build. Prettier + ESLint for code quality. Mobile-first responsive design. Dark/light mode toggle via CSS variables. Static site deployment (Vercel/Netlify).

tickets.title: Convert Stitch hero landing screen to React page component
tickets.description: Extract HTML/CSS from Stitch screen. Create src/pages/HeroLanding.jsx. Replace static paths with Vite asset imports. Add aria-labels for accessibility. Ensure responsive breakpoints match design. Extract reusable Button component if repeated.

tickets.title: Convert showcase explore section to React page component
tickets.description: Create src/pages/ShowcaseExplore.jsx. Implement horizontal scroll for project cards. Extract ProjectCard component if repeated. Add smooth scroll behavior. Ensure touch support for mobile.
acceptance_criteria: Horizontal scroll works on all devices

tickets.title: Convert services & projects screen to React page component
tickets.description: Create src/pages/ServicesProjects.jsx. Implement tabbed interface for services/projects. Extract ServiceCard component. Add fade-in animation on tab switch. Ensure keyboard navigation support.
acceptance_criteria: Tab switching works without page reload

tickets.title: Convert marquee about section to React page component
tickets.description: Create src/pages/AboutMarquee.jsx. Implement auto-scrolling marquee text. Add pause on hover. Extract Marquee component if reusable. Ensure marquee speed matches design (40px/s).

tickets.title: Convert collection footer section to React page component
tickets.description: Create src/pages/Footer.jsx. Implement 3-column layout. Add social media icons (SVG imports). Extract NewsletterSignup component if form exists. Ensure footer sticks to bottom on short pages.
acceptance_criteria: Social links open in new tab

tickets.title: Convert project inquiry/contact screens to React page components
tickets.description: Create src/pages/ProjectInquiry.jsx and src/pages/Contact.jsx. Implement form validation (required fields, email format). Add success/error states. Extract FormInput component. Ensure form submission logs to console (placeholder).

tickets.title: Extract reusable UI components from component reference screens
tickets.description: Create src/components/Button.jsx, src/components/Badge.jsx, src/components/Table.jsx. Implement all variants from Stitch screens. Add PropTypes. Ensure components match design tokens (colors, spacing, typography).
acceptance_criteria: All variants from Stitch screens implemented

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create src/App.jsx. Implement React Router v6 routes for all pages. Add navigation bar with active state. Implement dark/light mode toggle (CSS variables). Ensure 404 page. Add scroll-to-top on route change. Set up global styles (src/index.css).
acceptance_criteria: No layout shift on route change
